name: permission-request-chime-windows
description: Play a local Windows sound whenever Codex creates a permission request.

interface.shortDescription: Play a Windows chime when Codex asks for permission.
interface.longDescription: Permission Request Chime (Windows) bundles a Codex PermissionRequest lifecycle hook that plays a local Windows system sound as soon as an approval request is created. Install this version on Windows. macOS users should install Permission Request Chime (macOS).
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me configure the Windows permission request chime.
